Based on the `devto-articles` index in Elasticsearch, here are your articles covering **Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4** (including cross-cloud/multi-GPU comparisons on NVIDIA T4 hardware) and the speed-ups they report:

---

### 1. Core "Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4" Series (GCE + vLLM)

1. **[Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4: QAT Weights Decode 1.79x Faster Than bf16](https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-qat-weights-decode-179x-faster-than-bf16-2fi4)**  
   - **URL:** `https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-qat-weights-decode-179x-faster-than-bf16-2fi4`
   - **Setup:** Gemma 4 E2B (`google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-w4a16-ct` vs. `google/gemma-4-E2B-it` bf16) served by vLLM 0.29.0 on 1× Tesla T4 (`n1-standard-2`).
   - **Speed-ups reported:**
     - **1.79x faster per-stream decode** at concurrency 1 with 512-token prompts (**72.31 tok/s** vs. **40.44 tok/s**; total output throughput at $c=1$ is **62.27 tok/s** vs. **37.04 tok/s**, or **1.68x**).
     - **1.31x faster total output throughput** at 8 concurrent streams with 512-token prompts (**215.91 tok/s** vs. **164.62 tok/s**; at $c=4$: **157.49** vs. **109.05 tok/s** [**1.44x**]; at $c=16$: **213.79** vs. **164.36 tok/s** [**1.30x**]).
     - **2.47x fewer bytes read per decode token** (**1.862 GB** vs. **4.597 GB**), raising the 277.0 GB/s bandwidth ceiling from **60.3 tok/s** to **148.8 tok/s** and expanding the KV cache pool by **1.64x** (**519,568** vs. **315,974** tokens).
     - At **4,096-token prompts**, both builds converge at **~15–16 tok/s** ($c=1$: **14.00** vs. **12.11 tok/s** [**1.16x**]; $c=8$: **15.95** vs. **15.66 tok/s**) because prefill dominates.

2. **[Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4, Part 2: The Minimum GCE VM and a Script to Drive It](https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-part-2-the-minimum-gce-vm-and-a-script-to-drive-it-3gk1)**  
   - **URL:** `https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-part-2-the-minimum-gce-vm-and-a-script-to-drive-it-3gk1`
   - **Setup:** Minimum GCE VM (`n1-standard-2` + 1× Tesla T4) and the `vllm-t4` control script running `google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-w4a16-ct`.
   - **Speed-ups reported:**
     - Defers checkpoint decode speed comparisons to Part 1, and measures startup/operational speed-ups: a warm `torch.compile` cache cuts compile time from **112.77 s to 2.59 s** (**~43.5x faster** compile step; **362 s** total cold VM start-to-healthy endpoint).

3. **[Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4, Part 3: Int4 Embeddings Serve E2B in 2.86 GiB at 2.30x bf16](https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-part-3-int4-embeddings-serve-e2b-in-286-gib-at-230x-bf16-3kch)**  
   - **URL:** `https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-part-3-int4-embeddings-serve-e2b-in-286-gib-at-230x-bf16-3kch`
   - **Setup:** Text-only E2B with `embed_tokens_per_layer`, `embed_tokens`, and untied `lm_head` packed to int4 (`xbill9/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct-text-emb4`) on 1× Tesla T4.
   - **Speed-ups reported:**
     - **2.30x faster than bf16** and **1.37x (+37%) faster than Google's QAT W4A16** on a single 512-token request ($c=1$: **85.28 tok/s** vs. **37.04 tok/s** bf16 and **62.27 tok/s** QAT W4A16).
     - **1.68x faster than bf16** (**+16%** over QAT W4A16) at $c=4$ (**183.08 tok/s** vs. **109.05** bf16 and **157.49** QAT).
     - **1.46x faster than bf16** (**1.11x / +11%** over QAT W4A16) at $c=8$ (**239.64 tok/s** vs. **164.62** bf16 and **215.91** QAT), and **1.44x faster than bf16** (**+11%** over QAT) at $c=16$ (**237.08 tok/s**).
     - **+3% to +7% faster than QAT W4A16** (and **1.24x** over bf16 at $c=1$) on 4,096-token prompts ($c=1$: **15.03 tok/s** vs. **14.00** QAT and **12.11** bf16).
     - **1.34x single-stream decode speed-up** isolating the int4 `embed_tokens` + `lm_head` change on 256-token decodes (**109.7 tok/s** vs. **81.6 tok/s** with bf16 embeddings).
     - **1.35x decode speed-up** from speculative decoding with Google's MTP drafter (`gemma4_mtp`, 3 draft tokens) under greedy decoding (median TPOT drops from **9.9 ms to 7.4 ms**), and **1.13x** with default sampling (**9.8 ms to 8.7 ms**).
     - **1.87x faster than W8A8** at $c=1$ (**85.28 vs. 45.67 tok/s**) and **1.32x faster than W8A8** at $c=8$ (**239.64 vs. 181.25 tok/s**).
     - Expands KV cache capacity by **3.48x over bf16** (**1,099,587** vs. **315,974** tokens) by shrinking loaded weights from **9.8 GiB to 2.86 GiB**.

---

### 2. Thermal, Speculative Decoding & Multi-Tenant Tesla T4 Studies

4. **[Don't Assume Your Cloud T4 Runs at Spec: Gemma 4 Decode Falls 7% as the Card Warms](https://dev.to/gde/dont-assume-your-cloud-t4-runs-at-spec-gemma-4-decode-falls-7-as-the-card-warms-3fd3)**  
   - **URL:** `https://dev.to/gde/dont-assume-your-cloud-t4-runs-at-spec-gemma-4-decode-falls-7-as-the-card-warms-3fd3`
   - **Setup:** Gemma 4 E2B 4-bit (`emb4`) on a GCE Tesla T4 testing a 4-bit QAT MTP drafter (`qat-n3`, 3 draft tokens) and thermal clock drift.
   - **Speed-ups & thermal effects reported:**
     - **1.297x–1.298x speculative decoding speed-up** with the 4-bit `qat-n3` drafter when cooling the T4 to 50 °C before each run (**144.3 vs. 111.1 tok/s** and **144.6 vs. 111.5 tok/s**).
     - Without cooling between runs, the 70 W power cap pulls clocks down as the GPU warms from 45 °C to 77 °C, causing a **7.4% (and 6.3%) decode slowdown** (**115.3 tok/s down to 106.8 tok/s**) and distorting back-to-back drafter benchmarks to **1.279x** (baseline first) or **1.337x** (drafter first).

5. **[Renting Out One T4 to Three Customers: Gemma 4, vLLM Multi-LoRA and a Rust Gateway](https://dev.to/gde/renting-out-one-t4-to-three-customers-gemma-4-vllm-multi-lora-and-a-rust-gateway-3322)**  
   - **URL:** `https://dev.to/gde/renting-out-one-t4-to-three-customers-gemma-4-vllm-multi-lora-and-a-rust-gateway-3322`
   - **Setup:** Multi-tenant Gemma 4 E2B (`emb4`) + 3 LoRA adapters on 1× Tesla T4 behind a Rust gateway (`vllm-t4-gateway`).
   - **Speed-ups (latency reductions) reported:**
     - Under a noisy-neighbor flood of 4,096-token prompts from Tenant A, Tenants B and C see median time-to-first-token (TTFT) degrade from **0.28 s** to **29.90 s** (p95 **44.49 s**).
     - Enabling vLLM priority scheduling (`--scheduling-policy priority`) speeds up B and C's median TTFT by **~4.59x** (**29.90 s down to 6.52 s**) and p95 TTFT by **~3.02x** (**44.49 s down to 14.71 s**).
     - Combining priority scheduling with the Rust gateway's per-tenant in-flight cap (`max_inflight = 1`) speeds up p95 TTFT by **~3.67x** over unprioritized (**44.49 s down to 12.11 s**, with median TTFT at **7.06 s** / **~4.24x** faster).

---

### 3. GGUF Quantization Ladder on Tesla T4 (llama.cpp)

6. **[Accuracy vs Speed: Gemma 4 E2B Quantization Tradeoffs, BF16 to Q2_K](https://dev.to/gde/accuracy-vs-speed-gemma-4-e2b-quantization-tradeoffs-bf16-to-q2k-aea)**  
   - **URL:** `https://dev.to/gde/accuracy-vs-speed-gemma-4-e2b-quantization-tradeoffs-bf16-to-q2k-aea`
   - **Setup:** Gemma 4 E2B across 9 GGUF quantization rungs + Google QAT Q4_0 on 1× GCE Tesla T4 (`llama.cpp b11699`, 250 GSM8K questions).
   - **Speed-ups reported (vs. BF16 baseline at 40.0 tok/s):**
     - **Q4_0:** **2.34x** BF16 decode speed (**93.6 tok/s**, fastest rung on T4) and **1.19x** Q5_K_M's speed.
     - **Google QAT Q4_0:** **2.20x** BF16 decode speed (**87.8 tok/s**).
     - **Q4_K_M:** **2.10x** BF16 decode speed (**84.1 tok/s**).
     - **Q5_K_M:** **1.97x** BF16 decode speed (**78.7 tok/s**) at 39% of BF16 bytes with no accuracy loss (92.4% vs. 91.6% GSM8K).
     - **Other rungs on T4:** **Q3_K_M** at **1.86x** (**74.2 tok/s**), **Q2_K** at **1.85x** (**74.0 tok/s**), **Q6_K** at **1.77x** (**70.8 tok/s**), **Q8_0** at **1.61x** (**64.3 tok/s**), and **F16** at **0.99x** (**39.6 tok/s**).
     - Enabling thinking mode runs decode at **0.79x to 0.93x** of thinking-off speed and takes **2.22x to 2.70x** longer wall time per rung.

7. **[Performance vs Quality: Gemma 4 E2B Quantization on an NVIDIA L4 and a Tesla T4](https://dev.to/gde/performance-vs-quality-gemma-4-e2b-quantization-on-an-nvidia-l4-and-a-tesla-t4-4b90)** *(also published under AWS Builders at [https://dev.to/aws-builders/performance-vs-quality-gemma-4-e2b-quantization-on-an-nvidia-l4-and-a-tesla-t4-404g](https://dev.to/aws-builders/performance-vs-quality-gemma-4-e2b-quantization-on-an-nvidia-l4-and-a-tesla-t4-404g))*  
   - **URLs:**
     - `https://dev.to/gde/performance-vs-quality-gemma-4-e2b-quantization-on-an-nvidia-l4-and-a-tesla-t4-4b90`
